tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: On January 28, 2025 Company had received copy of order in Form DRC-22 from Office of Joint Commissioner of State Tax, Investigation-B, Mumbai directing Union Bank of India and State Bank of India to provisionally attach (debit freeze) the operative bank account of the Company held in these banks. On February 5, 2025 the Company had received copy of order in Form DRC-23 directing Union Bank of India and State Bank of India to restore (un freeze) the provisionally attached operative bank account of the Company held with these banks. These orders were issued pursuant to the intimation of Tax ascertained amounting to Rs. 13.36 Crores along with applicable interest and penalty under Section 74(5) of MGST Act, 2017 for voluntary payment, for which reply was already submitted and the matter was pending with GST Department. In continuation of the same, the Company received the Show Cause Notice on the matter in respect of the financial year 2018-19 during Q1 FY 26 and in repect of the financial year 2019-20 during Q2 FY 26. The reply on these Show Cause Notices are already submitted.
